features.name: Action Plan Schema Validation, Pre-Action Isolation, and Scope Immutability
features.description: Enforces formal JSON Schema validation on proposed plan structures before requesting permission, limits pre-actions strictly to UI disclosures and internal reasoning, and freezes authorized plan scope post-approval (prohibiting additions and permitting only removal of uncompleted actions).

evidence.mechanic_summary: Validates the plan structure against action_plan_return_schema (Draft 2020-12), requiring explicit dependencies between subactions and actions, operational definitions for ambiguous terms, and full definition disclosure.
Limits pre-actions strictly to UI disclosures and internal reasoning from current conversation without accessing external sources, tools, or mutations prior to safe-word approval.

Restricts post_approval_change_control to 'remove_uncompleted_actions_or_subactions_only' with additions_allowed set to false, requiring an entirely new plan and approval if newly discovered work arises.

features.name: Authoritative Dependency Mapping and Sentinel Coordination
features.description: Provides machine-readable file-to-file dependency links and associated test/evaluation context mappings synchronized against a designated sentinel file.

evidence.mechanic_summary: Defines version 1 dependency map tracking dependents and context_files for Agents.md and send-to-gemini.js, coordinated via sentinel_file ChatMachines/GeminiSupervisor/dependency-sync-sentinel.json.

features.name: Instruction (U) and Proposal (P) Semantic Evaluation Protocol
features.description: Establishes foundational rules for semantic evaluation: U is dynamically constructed from user requests and context rules; P is characterized strictly as illustrative behavior; true outcomes indicate failed contract checks rather than compliance; and satisfying corrective actions must be dynamically derived rather than copied from worked examples.

evidence.mechanic_summary: Mandates "u_construction_rule" ("construct the current effective instruction U from the user request and applicable context rules, then compare the actual P with it") and "p_characterization_rule" ("Each P is illustrative, unless explicitly identified as an observed case; it is not a claim that the agent performed it").

Evaluates "question_for_every_case": "Does the current P fail a requirement of the current U in the same specific way demonstrated here?" with "true_meaning": "A true answer is a failed contract check, not successful compliance." and "false_meaning": "A false answer does not prove that all other requirements pass."

Specifies: "A correction column describes how the example would satisfy its own U. It must not be copied as a command into another task. For the current U, derive the satisfying action from that U's own words and rules."

features.name: Heuristic Contract Failure Mode Catalog and Evaluation Workflow
features.description: Provides an indexed catalog of 16 granular failure patterns between U and P (unexecuted promises, omissions, quantifier reductions, target drift, ordering reversals, missing evidence) evaluated via a standardized multi-case workflow.

evidence.mechanic_summary: Indexes 16 worked examples including Index 1 (action converted to future promise), Index 2 (omitted sub-action), Index 3 ('every' reduced to one), Index 4 (action directed to wrong file), Index 5/6 (forbidden edits to protected targets), Index 7 (redaction method substitution), Index 9 (execution order reversal), Index 14 (adding unrequested endpoint fields), and Index 15/16 (claiming completion without granular evidence or over partial work).

Iterates steps: 1. Resolve current user utterance and rules into U; 2. Identify proposed words, actions, and results in P; 3. Locate demonstrated requirement in current U; 4. Compare failure relationship; 5. Evaluate all cases independently.

features.name: Set-Theoretic Coverage Reduction Detection and Boundary Differentiation
features.description: Implements a set-theoretic test and 6-step algorithmic procedure to detect when instruction U mandates full coverage across domain D (R = D) but proposal P covers only a proper subset C (C ⊂ R), while preventing false matches on boundary failures (N1-N8) or plural nouns lacking explicit quantification.

evidence.mechanic_summary: Defines sets D (resolved applicable members), R (required members where U requires R = D), and C (covered members proposed or executed). Triggers when R = D, |R| >= 1, and C is a proper subset of R. Distinguishes from extra work outside D and unexecuted promises.

Requires that the operator establish the explicit source of complete-coverage quantification ('stated directly or inherited from a governing rule... as "all," "each," "both," a specified complete list') and explicitly disallows: "It cannot infer 'all' from the mere existence of a plural noun."

Details cases N1 through N8 demonstrating non-matches for coverage reduction: N2 (extra deletion is authorization failure, not coverage reduction), N5 (inactive branch condition), N6 (unexecuted promise), N7 (method error: pixelated vs blur), and N8 (target/destination accuracy failure).

Step 1: Quote full-coverage clause and resolve references; Step 2: Define qualifying set D and check branch activity; Step 3: Verify U strictly requires every member of D; Step 4: Identify proposed coverage and inspect completion evidence; Step 5: Name specific omitted member in D; Step 6: Return true only when coverage reduction is established, else false.
